As Ellis sets his sights on exploring the remote islands of the Pacific that you can only get to by boat, he realizes that he doesn't know how to sail.

Ellis Emmett's first stop is the Kingdom of Tonga  he befriends a local named Lofi, and the two set sail for the isolated island of Tofua  they explore a newly formed volcanic island, navigate treacherous coral reefs, and must hunt for their dinner.
Ellis sets sail for the islands of Fiji, where he faces bull sharks, partakes in ancient Fijian fire walking rituals and anchors in the remote Lau Islands.
Ellis has a brush with royalty on the island kingdoms of Wallis and Futuna.
